6.description: [Pending Restart] [Pending Patch] [Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage]: Corrected an issue where Illidan Stormrage would display unintended frost visuals during his Avatar of Hatred phase.

[Pending Restart] [Pending Patch] [Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage]: Removed the rendering of the standard area-of-effect indicator for all persistent area effects used by Illidan Stormrage. All effects that previously displayed an area indicator now have a 1-yard smaller radius, taking the player's own object radius into consideration. This should greatly improve FPS during the encounter.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage]: Mythic and Ascended. The empowered Eye Beam of Illidan Stormrage now follows its predetermined path even if a wall is in its way.

[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage]: Improved the fixate behavior of Shadow Parasites and Shadow Demons, now causing them to ignore any attempts to divert their attention from their current target.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage]: Illidan now delays his ability to throw a Glaive by 5 seconds after being released from Maiev’s traps.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage]: Illidan now resets his threat one second earlier after being released from Maiev’s traps, before he is able to attack again.

[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil]: Corrected an issue where Blood Shield would not apply to targets affected by an effect that reduced healing taken, even when said effect was self-applied and considered a positive buff.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil]: Corrected an issue where Living Blood could still spawn in elevated positions.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Reliquary of Souls]: The Essence of Desire’s Aura of Desire no longer benefits from any form of damage-increasing effects that may be applied to the boss.

[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Reliquary of Souls]: The Reliquary of Souls now interrupts the creation of new Veils of Souls once the Essence of Despair and the Essence of Desire fall below 20% health on Mythic and Ascended difficulty.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Shade of Akama]: Akama (not the Shade) can no longer take more than 1% of his health in damage from each instance of damage that hits him.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Supremus]: Corrected an issue where Supremus might fail to summon new minions if placed and held in specific locations.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [Supremus]: Corrected an issue where Supremus might fail to chase his correct target.
[Pending Restart] [Black Temple] [All Bosses]: Corrected several issues where bosses and their summons would not execute events, eventually causing them to get stuck.
[Pending Restart] [Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron]: Corrected an issue where left-behind bodies would go rogue and attack things on their own.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] - [Judgement of Arcane Wrath] - Now deals less damage whilst leveling, returning to full strength by level 60.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Son of Gruul] Ground Slam now properly starts scaling its damage from level 34, instead of level 1. This caused unintended high performance in low level battlegrounds and PvE. The damage at max level is unchanged.
